Use another letter for the output index instead of j, since j indexes the second list on the convolution page.
Use another letter for the input index instead of k, since k indexes the output list on the convolution page.
Use another letter for the wrap count instead of c, since c is the output list on the convolution page.
Use another letter for the layout permutation instead of sigma, since sigma is the last-axis exponent on the phase-twist page.
Use another letter for the layout permutation instead of sigma, since sigma is the Gaussian width on the gaussian-resampling page.
